documents.title: Recording - Conference Call with the Fund Managers, Analysts and Investors on October 29, 2026
Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results, Limited Review Report for September 30, 2026
Intimation of Conference Call with the Fund Managers, Analysts and Investors

analysis.summary: Wheels India Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial results, showing standalone gross revenues of Rs 1,386.07 crores and consolidated gross revenues of Rs 1,492.79 crores. Management estimated the capital expenditure for FY27 to be between Rs 400 crores and Rs 450 crores. The company outlined various strategic focus areas including growing exports, ramping up machining and fabrication capacities for windmills, and optimizing working capital. Key metrics indicated that standalone free cash flow was close to breakeven levels in Q1 FY27. Wheels India Limited reported a strong financial performance for Q4 FY26 and the full year, crossing INR 5,000 crores in annual revenue for the first time with a 16% growth over the previous year.

guidance.claim: Management estimated that the capex for FY27 will be between Rs 400 crores and Rs 450 crores.
guidance.quote: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs

guidance.claim: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 280 to Rs 300 crs.
guidance.quote: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 280 to Rs 300 crs

demand_outlook.claim: The company stated that it has a derived demand coming from automotive, truck, tractor, and construction segments, and cannot throw any numbers in terms of growth.
demand_outlook.quote: We have really a derived demand with our demand coming from the automotive, truck, tractor and construction segments. We can't throw any numbers in terms of growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent about INR 261 crores towards capex last year across the windmill business, aluminum business, off-road businesses, routine capex, and cost savings.
capex_expansion.quote: last year, we basically spent about INR261 crores towards capex, which is both in terms of investment towards the windmill business, aluminium business and a little bit of the off-road businesses and some routine capex and cost savings totalling INR261 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects capex in the current year to be between INR 280 crores to INR 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: And we expect in the current year, it will be between INR280 crores to INR300 crores of capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The company made investments last year to ramp up machining of large castings for windmills, which should fructify into business this year.
capex_expansion.quote: We've ramped up -- made investments last year to ramping up machining of large castings for windmills, and that should fructify in terms of business this year.

capex_expansion.claim: In the aluminum wheel business, capacity is currently at 42,000 per month and is increasing to 60,000 in a few months, and 80,000 by half year.
capex_expansion.quote: In aluminium wheels we currently have a capacity of about 42,000 per month. We are increasing it -- in a few months we are increasing it to 60,000 and then by half year, we'll increase it to 80,000.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex of FY26 is mainly towards expanding capacity for machining of large castings, windmill products, automotive aluminium & steel wheels, Earth mover and Big agri wheels apart from certain routine capex and cost saving projects.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex of FY26 is mainly towards expanding capacity for machining of large castings, windmill products, automotive aluminium & steel wheels, Earth mover and Big agri wheels apart from certain routine capex and cost saving projects.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a net profit of about INR 4 crores on forex for the current quarter and close to INR 10 crores as forex gain for the whole year.
margins_costs.quote: So in the current quarter, we had a profit of about INR4 crores as a net thing on the forex. And for the whole year, it is about close to INR10 crores as forex gain.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported present interest costs of around INR 26 crores to INR 27 crores a quarter, totaling about INR 111 crores for the whole year.
margins_costs.quote: See, the present interest cost is around INR26 crores, INR27 crores a quarter, totalling about INR111 crores for the whole year.

margins_costs.claim: Cost optimization is listed as a focus area with a thrust on profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Cost optimization, with a thrust on profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: Passenger car steel wheel capacity for Wheels India and its subsidiary combined is about 11 million to 12 million, and is being expanded to 13.5 million up to 14 million.
orders_capacity.quote: So if you take passenger car, steel wheels between us and our subsidiary, if I look at it combined, I think Wheels India has got a capacity of about 4 million and the subsidiary has got a capacity of about 7 million. So about 11 million to 12 million is the capacity. We are adding capacity in the subsidiaries, so it will go to maybe 13.5 million up to 14 million.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a tractor wheel capacity of 50,000 a month for larger wheels.
orders_capacity.quote: take the tractor industry, if you count it in terms of the larger wheels as opposed to the smaller wheels, we have a capacity of 50,000 a month.

orders_capacity.claim: Commercial vehicle space capacity including light commercial vehicle is about 250,000 and will be increased to 300,000.
orders_capacity.quote: Commercial vehicle space, if you look at it, we have a capacity -- including the light commercial vehicle, if you look at it, we have about 250,000 capacity and we'll probably look at increasing that to 300,000 capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Light construction wheels capacity is about 25,000 to 30,000 depending on the mix, while medium to heavy-duty construction wheels capacity is about 16,000 wheels.
orders_capacity.quote: In the light construction wheels, we have a capacity of about 25,000 to 30,000 depending on the mix. So this broadly covers capacities.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that debt has been stable to declining, and debt equity and debt-to-EBITDA have improved.
capital_allocation.quote: Our debt has been stable to declining. Debt equity has improved. Debt-to-EBITDA has improved and free cash flows are reasonably strong

capital_allocation.claim: The company aims to increase its stake in Axles India to around 15%, or slightly higher to 20%, 25% over a period of time.
capital_allocation.quote: So the idea was that Wheels India can get improve its stake, so we are looking at maybe something like 15%, maybe slightly higher, 20%, 25% over a period of time.

capital_allocation.claim: Free Cash Flow stands at 83Crs in FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Free Cash Flow (FCF) stands at 83Crs in FY26

capital_allocation.claim: Debt is maintained at FY25 levels.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt is maintained at FY25 levels.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the West Asia crisis has affected fuel costs, fuel availability, and aluminum pricing, requiring re-sourcing of aluminum.
risks_headwinds.quote: Fuel availability was an issue. Fortunately, now it is only inflation that's an issue, not so much fuel cost. Aluminium, we were buying major quantities from the Middle East. So we had to re-source and also aluminium prices have gone up.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that the CBAM tax liability introduced in Europe on exports has been provided and booked under other expenses.
risks_headwinds.quote: So one of our products which we export to Europe has a CBAM tax liability, which is provided and it is booked under other expenses.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that there is pressure to have an India Plus One manufacturing strategy and to de-risk sourcing.
risks_headwinds.quote: But there is pressure also to have as they call it, India Plus One manufacturing strategy. And we are contemplating whether it's possible to, in a cost-effective way, add capacity in those geographies more to answer de-risking questions that the sourcing guys ask us.

management_commitments.claim: Management provided an estimate for FY27 capex to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crores.
management_commitments.quote: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs

management_commitments.claim: The company stated strategies to grow exports of wheels for construction equipment and agricultural tractors.
management_commitments.quote: Grow exports of wheels for construction equipment and agricultural tractors

management_commitments.claim: The company targeted to grow the hydraulic cylinder business.
The company aimed to ramp-up the cast aluminium wheel business.
The company aimed to fund capex predominantly through accruals and holding debt at current levels.
management_commitments.quote: Fund capex predominantly thro accruals and holding the debt at current levels

management_commitments.claim: Management expects double-digit EBITDA to happen from strategy and turnaround of loss-making businesses in 1 or 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: I think as and when that happens, I think we're probably 2 years away -- 1 or 2 years away from double-digit EBITDA. I don't think it should take longer than that.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims for an ROCE of 18% plus and a return on equity of 15% plus.
management_commitments.quote: I would look at our ROCE being 18% plus, I would look at our return on equity to be 15% plus.

management_commitments.claim: The long-term plan is to reduce engagement in rented facilities, move into owned facilities, and consolidate operations.
management_commitments.quote: So the long-term plan is to reduce our engagement in rented facilities and move into an own facility and consolidate operations from a number of different sites to one site so that we get both scale and efficiencies.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to continue making investments to grow the company while working on core competencies.
management_commitments.quote: and we will continue to make investments so that we can grow our company at the same time, work on our core competencies to see how we can take it forward on the constant strategy that we have spelled in front of us.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to ramp-up the expanded facility for machining of large castings for windmills and step up the capacity and volumes of fabricated, structural parts for windmills, including off-shore WEGs.
management_commitments.quote: Ramp-up the expanded facility for machining of large castings for windmills; Also Step up the capacity and volumes of the fabricated, structural parts for windmills, including off-shore WEGs

management_commitments.claim: Management seeks to grow bus air suspension business.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
